name: 複数の人が反応した投稿の通知
prompt:
Create a crisp flat Japanese notification component at exactly 390×198 pixels. Use reference image 1 (native preview) as the exact source of Japanese wording, layout, positions, sizes and typography. Use reference image 2 as the original visual reference, and reference images 3–5 for the exact original heart and reaction glyph shapes. Keep the Japanese version; do not copy any English source text.

Header at x16 y8: 山田さんと佐藤さんが「交流のアイデア」で反応, 12px Meiryo Regular. Keep the text neutral gray #6E6E6E except the linked channel name 交流のアイデア, which must be blue #1976D2 with no underline. Name 田中 あおい at x64 y42 in 14px Meiryo Bold #1D1D1D. Body at x64 y74 with exact two lines: 次の話し合いに向けて / 準備したい内容です。 Use 14px Meiryo Regular #1D1D1D with 24px line spacing.

At x20.7 y49.9 use a solid red heart icon matching reference image 3, about 22.5×19px; the current green outline heart is incorrect. At x64 y140 make the 賛同 1 reaction chip 86×32px; at x160 y140 make the ハート 1 chip 102×32px. Keep both Japanese labels and counts, with the source thumbs-up and heart emoji glyphs from reference images 4 and 5 before each label. Use neutral gray #F2F2F2 chip fills and neutral dark text #1D1D1D, with no mint tint, no green text and no shadow. Divider at x0 y186, width390, height1, neutral #E8ECE9.

Use a pure white page. No tinted surfaces, colored cards, gradients, shadows, extra controls, extra text or outer margins. Keep exact Japanese wording, source icon silhouettes and the native compact layout. Return only the flat component.
reviewNotes: The solid red heart and original reaction emoji shapes match the source; channel mention is blue and chips have neutral gray fills. Name/body are about 3px low and chips/divider 4–5px high versus native; retain needs-correction for one alignment pass.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.purpose: Match the original source heart and reaction glyphs while preserving Japanese native copy, blue linked channel text, and untinted neutral surfaces.
